clips.title: The story
paras: Forgotten Loa Idols centers on recovering sacred religious effigies for the Darkspear trolls. These lost relics are urgently needed to resume vital spiritual ceremonies and preserve the tribe's enduring bond of reverence with their patron wild spirits.

For the Darkspear trolls, spiritual balance is inextricably bound to their connection with the loa—the primal animal spirits and wild gods of their ancestral heritage. Forgotten Loa Idols involves recovering displaced religious relics essential for conducting tribal ceremonies. Without these sacred objects, spiritual leaders cannot perform the rites required to maintain harmony with their divine guardians.

While several hostile troll factions across Azeroth practice blood sacrifices or seek to compel spirits by force, the Darkspear pride themselves on maintaining a bond of mutual respect and humble reverence. To the Darkspear, falling out of favor with their patrons is a grave catastrophe, making the restoration of these lost idols a vital act of tribal preservation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe.
The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles.
This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter.
Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found our loa idols, friend? We must begin our rituals again soon.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done a great deed for our tribe today.
Unlike some tribes, our kinship with our loa is one of reverence and respect, and we owe them much.
I would not want the Darkspear to fall out of favor with them.
